lines.text: Library support is improving but not yet complete.

In summary: - True parallelism with up to ~3x speedup on 4 cores for CPU-bound tasks - Single-threaded overhead reduced to 5-10% - Separate interpreter binary python3.14t - Silent fallback to GIL if unsafe C extensions are loaded - Best for CPU-bound, multi-threaded pure Python workloads - Library ecosystem still catching up - New concurrent.futures.InterpreterPoolExecutor for isolated interpreters without GIL contention.
